verdict.rationale: The only cloud-side capability in the evidence is the GitHub integration: users can mention @gemini-cli in issues and pull requests for 'task delegation' and automated PR reviews, and the CLI can run non-interactively in scripts. Nothing shows a hosted agent that autonomously builds, tests, and demos a feature for review. Community reports of the agent looping and failing at agentic tasks lower confidence. missing for 10: dedicated cloud/background agent execution environment, autonomous test running and verification, demo artifacts (preview, screenshots, video) for review, end-to-end feature-to-PR workflow documentation, independent corroboration of delegated tasks succeeding.
